evidence_items.claim: Native Model Context Protocol (MCP) daemon runs local child processes via /bin/zsh and manages JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio pipes
evidence_items.extracted_details: Spawns /bin/zsh with inherited macOS PATH; implements initialize, tools/list, tools/call; enforces server name regex [a-zA-Z0-9_-]; persists in preferences perplexity.mcp.stdio_servers.

evidence_items.claim: Declarative WebMCP is integrated natively into Blink rendering engine via HTMLFormElement and InspectorWebMCPAgent
symbols_and_sources: void blink::ModelContext::ExecuteDeclarativeTool(DeclarativeWebMCPTool *, const base::UnguessableToken &, const String &, AbortController *, ScriptToolExecutedCallback)
evidence_items.extracted_details: Allows web pages to declare MCP tools natively using HTML forms; exposed through dedicated CDP domain WebMCP.

evidence_items.claim: Comet Agent implements Anthropic Computer-Use batching with atomic coordinate scaling and viewport drift aborts
evidence_items.extracted_details: Executes SCREENSHOT, WAIT, LEFT_CLICK, RIGHT_CLICK, DOUBLE_CLICK, TRIPLE_CLICK, TYPE, KEY, SCROLL, LEFT_CLICK_DRAG, SCROLL_TO; checks _P(lastViewport, currentViewport) before execution to prevent misclicking on drifted layouts.

evidence_items.claim: Hybrid perception combines Accessibility.getFullAXTree with DOMSnapshot.captureSnapshot into indexed YAML
evidence_items.extracted_details: Evaluates DPR and location.origin, captures computed cursor styles and full AX tree, filters out overlay elements, and generates token-efficient YAML indexed by backendNodeId references.

evidence_items.claim: Typing emulation uses clipboard swapping with state restoration to bypass synthetic input blockers
evidence_items.extracted_details: Attempts Input.pasteFromString first; falls back to saving existing clipboard, writing payload as ClipboardItem, dispatching ControlOrMeta+KeyV, and restoring previous clipboard.

evidence_items.claim: Agent loop features automatic CDP detachment reattachment and timeout reload recovery in RPC dispatcher
evidence_items.extracted_details: Catches 'Debugger is not attached' and 'Detached while handling command', immediately calls IA(tabId) to reattach and retries command; catches timeouts and reloads tab before reattaching.

evidence_items.claim: Subagents are spawned concurrently in isolated, hidden background tabs
evidence_items.extracted_details: Dispatches kP with is_subagent: true and isHidden: true; groups subagent tabs separately without stealing foreground window focus.

evidence_items.claim: Frontend SPA intercepts streaming tool calls via StreamMiddlewares and connects to ASI WebSocket
evidence_items.extracted_details: Intercepts streaming response chunks directly in React state pipeline; dispatches START_AGENT, connectAsi, getCookies, or S3-uploaded tab screenshots.

evidence_items.claim: Live HUD injects glowing gradient boundary, ripple clicks, and pause/resume button with permission gating
evidence_items.extracted_details: Creates rotating conic gradient HUD with pause/resume button; dispatches BROWSER_TASK_PAUSE_RESUME; presents confirmation prompts for sensitive actions (ALWAYS_ALLOW, ALLOW_ONCE, SKIP).

evidence_items.claim: macOS Seatbelt sandbox uses custom PartitionAlloc allocator wrapper in libaperitif.dylib
evidence_items.extracted_details: Initializes macOS seatbelt sandbox server and hooks default malloc zone to PartitionAlloc for browser helper processes.
